onboarding.intro.text: FIXX Verified confirms your identity only. It does not verify skills, licenses, certifications, references or insurance.

onboarding.missing.text: Add your ID, a selfie and verify your phone to continue.

onboarding.pending.text: We are reviewing your documents. This usually does not take long.

onboarding.rejected.text: We could not verify your identity: {reason}. You can fix it and send your documents again.

recovery.intro.text: Send a new selfie and verify your new number. Our team reviews it before you can take jobs again.

payout.invalid.text: A CLABE has 18 digits. Check it and try again.

payout.draftNote.text: Draft copy: the payout account wording is still to be written.

dash.noScore.text: No score yet. It starts after your first jobs.

dash.scoreNote.text: The score reflects quality and reliability: the FIXX Standard, checklists and showing up. It is separate from customer ratings.

dash.levelsNote.text: Requirements for FIXX Pro and FIXX Expert are still to be defined.

dash.ratingAvg.text: {avg} of 5 from {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}}

dash.penalties.text: {count, plural, one {# late cancellation or no-show recorded} other {# late cancellations or no-shows recorded}}

dash.noJobs.text: No job requests right now. Quiet day, enjoy the coffee.

dash.noJobsHint.text: Demo: switch to Customer, send a request and choose this professional.

sched.note.text: Customers only see times when you are free.

pquote.limits.text: You can adjust it between {min} and {max}.

pquote.reasonNeeded.text: Add a reason when you change the suggested payout.

pquote.outOfLimits.text: That payout is outside the allowed range.

pquote.travel.text: Travel fee you receive if the customer cancels after you are on the way: {amount}

pquote.sent.text: Quote sent. We will tell you when the customer answers.

pquote.waitingDeposit.text: The customer accepted. Waiting for the deposit.

work.onWayNote.text: The customer is notified when you tap this.

work.fixxStandard.text: The FIXX Standard always wins over your usual method.

checklist.walkthrough.text: Walk the customer through the result

work.checklistFirst.text: Tick every item to finish the checklist.

work.completeNote.text: Marking the job complete asks the customer to check the work. Your balance stays pending until they approve, or until the release time.

work.waitWindow.text: Waiting for the customer to approve. Your balance releases when they approve, or at the release time if they do not answer.

work.payoutReleased.text: Your payout of {amount} was released. It arrives today.

work.countdown.text: Releases {when}. About {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} left.

work.sameChecklist.text: This is the same list the customer sees at the end. It does not block you.

work.photosNeed.text: Add at least {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} to continue.

work.returnBody.text: You have the first chance to fix this before {when}.
